title: Overdrawn accounts
statementMd:
List accounts whose transaction total is negative. Show account id and balance rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `account_id`, `balance`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT account_id, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS balance FROM transactions GROUP BY account_id HAVING SUM(amount) < 0;
```
